text:
Save this before you book a "Fuji view" room at Lake Kawaguchi: four checks that tell you whether the mountain is really in your window or just in the photos 👇

📋 THE CHECKLIST

1️⃣ Read the room type, not the hotel name. On our sample night, a hotel called Fuji View sold garden- and courtyard-view rooms as well as one room type called "Mt.Fuji View".

2️⃣ Compare like with like. Same hotel, same size, same meals: that gap is the true price of the view. Ours was ¥8,280 for two (¥61,020 vs ¥52,740, 36 m², breakfast).

3️⃣ Watch for "selected at check-in". It cost ¥8,170 more than the room sold as "No View" at one ryokan, and the view was still up to the front desk.

4️⃣ Find where the photo was taken. If it's a bath, a lounge or a terrace, check the hours. The top-floor bath we checked opens at 5:00, before sunrise.

💡 IF YOU SKIP THE UPGRADE

🌉 The Kawaguchiko Ohashi Bridge has a footpath and is a classic Fuji viewpoint. Stay on the path, never on the road.

🪞 On a still morning, the tourism association says the reflection shows along most of the north shore, most likely right from daybreak.

🗓️ Check the free-cancellation date too. Both paid view rooms we priced had to be cancelled a week before the stay.
